window_stability_floor.description: Per-window cell floor (sec 5.1, DP-21), distinct from the per-endpoint ranking-set floor above: each of the four registered sec 2.2 windows (Half A, Half B, and the two arms of whichever partition the branch registers -- platform-label STRONG/NOTSTRONG in every branch, plus bar-only tape BENIGN/HOSTILE if the SPY-from-2025-01-02 history is delivered) needs >= 20 contributing nights to enter the stability test; below 20 a window prints its count, leaves the stability test, and is named -- and after the single DP-13 extension, no objective may be named strongest unless all four windows in the branch clear 20 (DECISIONS item 14, Correction 5).

scheduling_rate_cap.description: Scheduling rate = min(r_rank,60, 0.6620) (DECISIONS items 7, 8). 0.6620 = 47/71, the desk's measured published-pick contributing rate, cited from STEWARD_Q031_exposure.md sec (a) (reconfirmed by STEWARD_Q032_exposure.md sec (a)(ii)) -- not recomputed here. r_rank,60 = 10/11 = 0.9091, the ranking-set rate on the t+60-evaluable sub-period, cited from STEWARD_Q034_exposure.md sec (b). The cap (0.6620) is the binding half: no date is ever computed from a rate faster than the desk's own measured published-pick number. SCHEDULE_AUDIT.md flags that Q033/Q034 cap planning on Q031's 0.6620 and carry their own 40/60-session endpoints with their own maturity clocks, and cautions that the 20-session illustrative scenarios in that audit's table do not apply to Q034.

notes: elapsed_sessions = 0 because the registered window (pick nights 2026-09-15..2027-04-30) starts tomorrow relative to as_of 2026-09-14; every eligible/mature/contributing count is 0 by construction, not by shortfall.

This is a DIAGNOSTIC/objective-comparison question (PREREG sec 1): it registers no primary endpoint in the effect-size/MPE sense, no BH correction and computes no q-value. The nine objectives O1-O9 are listed here because the register's own >= 80-contributing-night reporting floor applies per-row (sec 5.1, DP-21); PROSPECTIVELY_CONFIRMED is declined in every branch.

eligible_nights/mature_nights/contributing_nights are identical across all nine endpoint rows because the >= 80-night floor is projected on the shared ranking set (sec 2.5, DECISIONS item 7) -- a night only enters the ranking set once every one of the nine objectives independently clears >= 3 valid picks with >= 5 valid controls. Each objective also has its own, generally larger, full-night-set count (not tracked here as a separate readiness field; see PREREG sec 4.3).

The binding maturity is 60 sessions uniformly for every objective's contributing-night gating (sec 2.3, sec 2.5: 'matured to t+60'), even though O1/O9 have a 5-session own clock and O3/O4/O6/O7 a 20-session own clock -- this is what SCHEDULE_AUDIT.md means by '40/60-session endpoints with their own maturity clocks': O5 and O8 carry the deepest (60-session) own clock, and it is the reason Q034's registered window is longer than its 20-session-clock siblings (Q009/Q010, Q002, Q033).

Per DECISIONS item 18 / Schedule section (final, recorded 2026-09-14 on STEWARD_Q034_exposure.md R1, counts only, cited not recomputed): binding floor is A (>=80 ranking-set nights, projected reached at session 121 = 2027-03-09); floor B (>=20 rarer-registered-window nights) projected reached at session 102 = 2027-02-09; floor C (DP-24, >=30 post-lock nights) at session 46 -- all inside the registered 158 sessions.

No manifest is pinned (pin_at_decision: true, schedule.json); the successor selection and price freezes (sec 5.3 R2) are ROUTED and OPEN, due before the decision date but not a blocker for lock (DP-23). Never queried live for these counts (rule 4).

SCHEDULE_AUDIT.md's caution is heeded here: the illustrative 20-session Q024/Q027/Q029 scenarios in that audit's table are explicitly NOT applied to Q034; Q034's own scheduling rate (min(0.9091, 0.6620) = 0.6620, cited from STEWARD_Q034_exposure.md and STEWARD_Q031_exposure.md, not recomputed) and its own 60-session-maturity endpoints (O5, O8) govern its schedule instead.
No hit rate, touch rate, return, effect, p-value or comparison is recorded anywhere in this file; results/ was not opened.
